title: Here's Why You Shouldn't Run From The Police #6
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On December 31, 2022, police were in a brief pursuit of a stolen vehicle in Fond du Lac, WI. The vehicle quickly pulled over and released two occupants while continuing to flee. Visual was soon lost. Minutes later, the suspect was located again and led law enforcement on a high-speed pursuit for several miles. Eventually, they acquired some air time off a curb, lost control, and ultimately struck a deputy head-on.

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
